answer.main_body: steam engine apparatus on a plinth
answer.evidence: The cylinder features a clearly drawn circular top lid spanning rows 8 to 14 (~7 rows), the base plinth shows a wide top surface from row 27 to 38, and the flywheel is drawn foreshortened in top-down 3/4 view.
